title: Silas and the Harvest
author: Rosalind Almeida
blurb: Ivo Voss, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
